selection_method: All 30 COD experimental parents listed in published E3 selection.json, with all five published damaged variants; sorted by parent ID. No selection based on PRIS outputs.
coordinate_provenance: Byte-identical copies of author-committed POSCAR.init inputs; these are experimental-source parent structures repackaged by authors, not original COD CIF downloads. S1-S5 are deliberately damaged copies, not experimental observations.
limitations: E3 is an author-selected DFT cross-check cohort of discovery-split parents with at most 16 sites where all five damage operators apply (dft/PREREG-DFT.md). It is not a random sample of all 99162 experimental structures and not the original large held-out PRIS benchmark.
The upstream TASK.json kind=experimental describes parent provenance for every variant; the manifest explicitly distinguishes experimental_parent from synthetic_damage.
COD URLs are traceability references derived from published source IDs; no current COD content was downloaded or verified by this packaging script.
